name: Curator Beastie
oracle_text:
Reach
Colorless creatures you control enter with two additional +1/+1 counters on them.
Whenever this creature enters or attacks, manifest dread. (Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)

needs.what: manifest dread (701.62a): look at the top two cards of your library, choose one and put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 manifested creature (turnable face up for its mana cost if it is a creature card), and put the other into your graveyard -- either a `dread: true` flag on the `manifest` op or a `manifest_dread` op
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `manifest` (amount, cloak, player) always manifests the top card with no choice and no second card to the graveyard; `look_at_top` can choose one of two and send the rest to the graveyard, but its `face_down` only means private exile and it cannot put a card onto the battlefield as a face-down manifested 2/2. Chaining mill + manifest would pick the wrong card with no choice.
